info.name: Fulcrum Public Accounting Code ScrapReport API

Returns scrap entries logged within the supplied date range. Both
dates are optional; the Domain layer defaults to the prior 90 days
when neither is supplied.

params.name: startDateUtc
params.description: Inclusive start of the report window (UTC). Defaults to today minus 90 days when omitted.

params.name: endDateUtc
params.description: Exclusive end of the report window (UTC). Defaults to tomorrow when omitted.
